units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:7">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>למדני עֲקִירָתָן</he> teach me, how to tear them out.—Pl. <he>עֲקִירוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 3a:6">Ib. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>עקירת גופו כעקירת חפץ וכ׳</he> is moving one’s body (starting to walk) like lifting an object from its place?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 1:3:3">Y. Hor. I, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>עקירת הגוף</he> a decision which abrogates a Biblical law entirely; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:1:6">Y. Yeb. X, 10ᵈ</cite> bot.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 47:1">Pesik. R. s. 47</cite> (ref. to <he>להשמידו</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 9:20">Deut. IX, 20</cite>) <he>עקירת בנים ובנות</he> extinction of sons and daughters (v. <cite ref="K00538"><he>כִּילּוּי</he></cite>).
